people: [gecko]u6bkep (19.24, Armada, team 0) and [gecko]Covariance (16.84, Armada, team 1); bases seen at A3/B4 (plant A3 2:53, commander B4 2:38) and B8/C8 (plant B8 5:20, commander C8 5:32, forward plant D8 8:44); which person held which base is not in the records. our_side: Three seats, factions Random, start boxes not honoured: t2 = seat 0 Cortex at G1 (north-east corner), t3 = seat 1 Armada at H8 (south-east), t4 = seat 2 Armada at G4 (middle-east). Each seat an Opus 5.5 medium player (Claude Code 2.1.292) under one Opus 5.5 high side commander; hands Jev jev-latest = jev-1.13.0; real time.
build: c515f12 (the banner chat line of every seat)
summary: Won at 24:22 when both people resigned (vote passed 24:22): three Opus seats under an Opus commander on Comet Catcher in real time against two Armada players based at A3/B4 and B8/C8. Our scouts and Blitzes won the first five minutes (18 Rovers, 7 extractors, 3 constructors of theirs dead by 4:48; side army about 3,500 to 770 seen at 5:00), but the push on A3 went in seat by seat under Sentries and commanders and traded even 5:00-6:48, and the commander kept the far base first, sending the two strong bodies into a two-Beamer nest at B4 (about 3,500 lost for 1,760 at 10:13-11:11) while the south player's forward plant at D8 (seen 8:44) fed Stouts into the weakest seat. The south seat's commander, sent out by its own player's packet to fight raiders at spot_75, died at 10:56 and the seat stopped building by 12:30. From 12:50 the side's economy (41-44 extractors to his 15-16 known) and one Pounder-Stout-artillery body killed the D8 plant, a 17-Stout block at C4 (17:30), the B4 commander (18:37) and the B4 and A3 plants; the second commander and the B8 plant died in the resignation burst at 24:23-24:26, not to our army. No person said more than gg; every 'because' here is the reader's or the commander's own note.

root.what: The first lead was spent piecemeal and the plan split the side: go_base at 4:48 sent t3's and t4's Blitzes by B5 without the gather (t2 arriving later from the north), and at 5:48 the commander chose the far base (A3) first with t2+t4 and left t3 alone beside the second player's B8 base. The A3 push traded even under Sentries and commanders, t3's army fell to 0.5x what it saw by 7:00, and every later cost (the B4 nest, the D8 Stouts, t3's commander, a 24-minute game) follows from fighting the far base first with the bodies apart. Reader's reading, built on the commander's own 6:48 note.
root.evidence: commander 5:48: 'we strike one base at a time: t4's and t2's bodies take his_base now ... t3 keeps base_sw busy without feeding it'; seat 2 #4 6:10-6:45 C5: lost 990 for 880 (911 vs 110 on the spot); seat 1 minutes 7:00 '423/770 (0.5)'

their_play: Two Armada vehicle players. Early Rovers came at G1 along row 1 (commander 2:18) and lost wholesale to our raiders; Blitz masses died in numbers (side fights lines: 16 Blitzes in the minute to 7:00, 14 to 8:00, 18 to 10:00, 20 to 11:00). The south player walked his commander forward and raised a vehicle plant at D8 (seen 8:44, 900 from t3's spot_78) whose Stouts (first seen 9:37) raided t3's strip 9:20-11:46 and killed its commander at 10:56. Beamer nests with commanders and Sentries at B4 (first Beamer 9:42) and D7 (9:53) beat head-on pushes. From 12:50 a Stout/Janus army in blocks of 14-17 ate our middle extractors at C3-E3 and D4-D6 (seat 0 lost 13, 10 of them to Stouts). Lazarus from 15:58 raised our Cortex wrecks (Pounders, Incisors, a Cortex constructor that built Cortex Sentries by 22:00). No advanced factory seen (no truth file); a Gauntlet frame at D8 at 24:00. They resigned at 24:22, one commander dead, their B4 and A3 plants gone and the D8 plant gone since 12:50.

bears_on.note: Seat bodies arriving separately traded even at B5/C5 (6:10-6:48) and lost at B4 (10:13-11:11); one body of t2's Pounders and t4's Stouts and artillery broke the C4 Stout block at 17:30. The commander's closing lesson: 'bodies of several seats arriving separately lose'.
3.5x to 6x the army seen at 3:00-6:00 with 18 Rovers and 7 extractors of his dead, not converted; the game ran to 24:22 and cost the south seat.
In a game against u6bkep himself, the head-on push into the B4 Beamer nest cost about 3,500 for 1,760; going round to the D8 plant then won the next fight.
Two Beamers with a commander and Sentries at B4 beat 5,000 of tier-1 tanks; the commander added Shellshockers and Wolverines (710) for nests at 10:48.
Artillery added three a seat behind the Stout and Pounder body, not as the body; the nests at B4 and A2-A3 fell to the body later.
t2's Pounder mass (35-54) with t4's Stouts beat his Stout/Janus army 15:00-18:00 (commander's closing note: 'Pounder mass worked vs Stout/Janus').
24-28k of our wrecks lay on held ground 21:27-24:27 and his Lazarus raised our Pounders, Incisors and a Cortex constructor against us.
The first units crossed at 2:16-2:46 and killed 18 Rovers, 7 extractors and 3 constructors by 4:48; the early raid gave the lead the rest of the game ran on.
12:36-12:58 both bodies committed on his commander at the D8 plant; it D-gunned five Blitzes and escaped into the D7 Beamer and D8 Sentries.
41-44 extractors to his 15-16 known from 9:00 to 12:00 carried the side through the loss of a seat.

bot.log, records' chat/given/taken/enemy events, a scratch script for enemy plant and commander sightings
lens.existing_review: none (no review.md or other review file in the match directory)
lens.caveats: No truth file: his army and buildings are what we saw (floors), his tier 2 cannot be ruled out, raid_ledger's 'paid' and floor's look_min/known% are empty. No ledger row. The tools read the first record only, so seats 1 and 2 were read through symlinked copies in the scratchpad. Start boxes were not honoured, so minutes.py's 'his half' (the mirror of each seat's start) is wrong here (seat 1's mirror G1 is our own seat 0): the his-half percentages are unreliable. pro_baseline found no pool for Cortex G1 or Armada H8, and G4's pool is duels. The second commander and the B8 plant died in the burst after the resign vote, so the commander's 'resigned after B8 fell and second commander died' has the order reversed. Which person played which base is unknown.

open_questions: Which person held A3/B4 and which B8/C8/D8? The records carry no team on enemy units; the engine replay would say.
Did the D8 plant stand before 9:37 and make the Stouts that killed t3's commander, or did they come from B8? No truth file.
Would the 3,500 at D5 sent to D8 at 8:44 instead of B4 have saved t3? Reader's counterfactual, untested.
Is the transfer tool still refused whole for one stale name, and did the 2026-10-17 chase fix change how the hands walk a commander into a party that outranges it on a packet step?
